## `awards` (`awards.parquet`, config `default`)

One row per row of SBIR.gov's bulk file `award_data_no_abstract.csv`, in the same order. Nothing is dropped, deduplicated or corrected.

Non-null and non-blank are shares of the table's rows; non-blank also leaves out empty strings.

| column | type | description | non-null | non-blank | example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | string | Added. First 12 hex characters of the SHA-1 of agency, branch, program, phase, company, award title, contract, agency tracking number, award year, award amount, proposal award date, UEI and DUNS. A row that repeats an earlier one in all of these gets `-2`, `-3`. SBIR.gov's file has no award id. Primary key. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `27a2432a2823` |
| `company` | string | Company. SBIR.gov: "Name of the business". As published, outer spaces removed (as for every text column). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `DOTTIR LABS, INC` |
| `award_title` | string | Award Title. SBIR.gov: "Title of the project". Some are `Not Available` or `N/A` as published. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Optical Raman Sensor Network for Persistent Coastal Water Qu...` |
| `agency` | string | Agency. SBIR.gov: "Agency making the award". The file says `Department of Defense` where SBIR.gov's site says Department of War. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Department of Commerce` |
| `branch` | string | Branch: the sub-unit of the agency (e.g. `Air Force`, `National Institutes of Health`). Blank for agencies with no sub-units listed. | 100.0% | 65.9% | `National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration` |
| `phase` | string | Phase: `Phase I`, `Phase II` or `Phase II – Direct to Phase II`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Phase I` |
| `program` | string | Program: `SBIR` or `STTR`. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `SBIR` |
| `agency_tracking_number` | string | Agency Tracking Number. SBIR.gov: "Unique code assigned by the agency/branch that made the Phase 1 submission". Not unique in the file. | 100.0% | 99.9% | `5095426` |
| `contract` | string | Contract. SBIR.gov labels it Contract/Grant #. Not unique: some agencies list one solicitation-wide number for many awards. | 100.0% | 76.3% | `NA26OARX021G0114` |
| `proposal_award_date` | date32[day] | Proposal Award Date. SBIR.gov: "The first day of contract performance". Blank on many rows; some dates are impossible as published (years like 1905 or 5025). | 51.5% | 51.5% | `2026-09-01` |
| `contract_end_date` | date32[day] | Contract End Date. SBIR.gov: "The last day of contract performance". | 49.2% | 49.2% | `2027-02-26` |
